name: TIME
doc: Global time since the engine has started, in seconds. It repeats after every 3,600 seconds (which can be changed with the rollover setting). It's affected by time_scale but not by pausing. If you need a TIME variable that is not affected by time scale, add your own global shader uniform and update it each frame.

name: PI
doc: A PI constant (3.141592). A ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter and amount of radians in half turn.

name: TAU
doc: A TAU constant (6.283185). An equivalent of PI * 2 and amount of radians in full turn.

name: E
doc: An E constant (2.718281). Euler's number and a base of the natural logarithm.

name: OUTPUT_IS_SRGB
doc: true when output is in sRGB color space (this is true in the Compatibility renderer, false in Forward+ and Mobile).

name: CLIP_SPACE_FAR
doc: Clip space far z value. In the Forward+ or Mobile renderers, it's 0.0. In the Compatibility renderer, it's -1.0.

name: VIEWPORT_SIZE
doc: Size of viewport (in pixels).

name: VIEW_MATRIX
doc: World space to view space transform.

name: INV_VIEW_MATRIX
doc: View space to world space transform.

name: MAIN_CAM_INV_VIEW_MATRIX
doc: View space to world space transform of camera used to draw the current viewport.

name: INV_PROJECTION_MATRIX
doc: Clip space to view space transform.

name: NODE_POSITION_WORLD
doc: Node position, in world space.

name: NODE_POSITION_VIEW
doc: Node position, in view space.

name: CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD
doc: Camera position, in world space. Represents the midpoint of the two eyes when in multiview/stereo rendering.

name: CAMERA_DIRECTION_WORLD
doc: Camera direction, in world space.

name: CAMERA_VISIBLE_LAYERS
doc: Cull layers of the camera rendering the current pass.

name: INSTANCE_ID
doc: Instance ID for instancing.

name: INSTANCE_CUSTOM
doc: Instance custom data (for particles, mostly).

name: VIEW_INDEX
doc: The view that we are rendering. VIEW_MONO_LEFT (0) for Mono (not multiview) or left eye, VIEW_RIGHT (1) for right eye.

name: VIEW_MONO_LEFT
doc: Constant for Mono or left eye, always 0.

name: VIEW_RIGHT
doc: Constant for right eye, always 1.

name: EYE_OFFSET
doc: Position offset for the eye being rendered, in view space. Only applicable for multiview rendering.

name: VERTEX
doc: Position of the vertex, in model space. In world space if world_vertex_coords is used.

name: VERTEX_ID
doc: The index of the current vertex in the vertex buffer.

name: NORMAL
doc: Normal in model space. In world space if world_vertex_coords is used.

name: TANGENT
doc: Tangent in model space. In world space if world_vertex_coords is used.

name: BINORMAL
doc: Binormal in model space. In world space if world_vertex_coords is used.

name: POSITION
doc: If written to, overrides final vertex position in clip space.

name: UV
doc: UV main channel.

name: UV2
doc: UV secondary channel.

name: COLOR
doc: Color from vertices.

name: ROUGHNESS
doc: Roughness for vertex lighting.

name: POINT_SIZE
doc: Point size for point rendering.

name: MODELVIEW_MATRIX
doc: Model/local space to view space transform (use if possible).

name: MODEL_MATRIX
doc: Model/local space to world space transform.

name: PROJECTION_MATRIX
doc: View space to clip space transform.

name: CUSTOM0
doc: Custom value from vertex primitive. When using extra UVs, xy is UV3 and zw is UV4.

name: CUSTOM1
doc: Custom value from vertex primitive. When using extra UVs, xy is UV5 and zw is UV6.

name: CUSTOM2
doc: Custom value from vertex primitive. When using extra UVs, xy is UV7 and zw is UV8.

name: CUSTOM3
doc: Custom value from vertex primitive.
